scientific_integrity: Exact integer enumeration and an exhaustive acyclic partial matching prove a finite CW homotopy model; modular boundary checks are corroboration, not a substitute for an integral proof.
scientific_limitations: One fixed Heawood graph; no higher-order projective-plane theorem and no equivariant homology assertion. The public literature comparison is not a guarantee against unindexed equivalent work.
title: Mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge homotopy of the Heawood general-position complex
